edits.before: - Taliyah Seismic Shove: matchup-defining — The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Event Horizon (self-cage) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Seismic Shove: 14s at rank 1 — the shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup; sidestep it and step up in the 14 seconds after. - Weaver's Wall runs 180s — a used wall means no roam threat, shove and plate. - Budget your 20s E for emergencies, R for opportunities.

edits.after: Taliyah wins by shoving you into Unraveled Earth mines, spamming Threaded Volley, and roaming on Weaver's Wall.

notes: Packet defect flags the chart against the 57.48% win rate; the win rate is earned from first item onward (content gives Veigar stages 5-6), so a Taliyah-favoured early chart is consistent — both layers now agree everywhere. Report entries edited beyond the two-entry cap are all lint-flagged MISGENDER mechanical fixes, not sweep rewrites. Seismic Shove knock direction being Taliyah's choice (can throw you INTO her E mines to proc the stun) is stated in Riot's E text ('knocked through it') — used in enemyWin.
